unavailable_fields.nvlink_bytes: Hardware counters require a successful collector-specific probe; additionally the NVLink probe returned not_supported (nvmlDeviceGetNvLinkState NVML status 3) and the observed NCCL transport is SHM/direct/direct on channels 00/01 with peer_access 0.1 and 1.0 both 0.0, so no NVLink P2P path is in use to attribute bytes to; retained unknown.
unavailable_fields.hardware_utilization: Hardware counters require a successful collector-specific probe; available NVML utilization is device-wide with device-dependent native periods (observed 0% at idle), not per-collective utilization.
unavailable_fields.per_collective_wire_bytes: No available collector attributes bus traffic to an individual collective: device_telemetry (not selected) samples device-wide rates with native windows, and PCIe/NVLink traffic must not be invented from logical payload or memcpy sizes; only logical_input_bytes=497759232 from the already-run torch trace are observed.
unavailable_fields.nccl_wait_vs_wire_separation: Nsys timelines alone do not separate NCCL in-kernel waiting from wire transfer, and the 34.601/33.079 ms kernel durations include waiting; only bounds via the warmed collective_calibration reference and the actual nccl_tuning decisions can be reported, never a direct split.
unavailable_fields.gpu_readiness_and_consumer_completion: execution_timeline reports clock alignment bounds for matching CPU submissions only; GPU readiness and consumer completion for the single allreduce may remain unknown, and cross-rank timestamps use the no-subtraction clock policy.
unavailable_fields.model_critical_path_ms: communication_without_compute_ms (34.601/33.079 ms) and compute_overlap_ms=0.0 are interval facts local to one trace clock; uncovered communication is not a measured critical path, and collective_calibration is a reference experiment, not a critical-path estimate; no collector measures the model critical path.
unavailable_fields.bucket_member_group_cost_allocation: Bucket identity is observed (single state:model bucket_index 0, is_last, all 148 parameters, gradient-storage membership plus matched parameter inventory), but the passive inventory records calls=[] and its interpretation states it does not allocate collective cost among member operator groups; per-group cost split stays unknown.

collection_plan.rationale: Frozen objective is median aligned max-rank clean step_ms with step_ms <= 1.05x original baseline, plus the separately profiled max-rank NCCL kernel-sum diagnostic. Trace evidence: exactly one matched cross-rank collective (sequence 11, allreduce, Float, 124439808 input elements, logical 497759232 bytes per rank) executed as one ncclDevKernel_AllReduce_Sum_f32_RING_LL kernel on stream 7 (34.601 ms rank 0 / 33.079 ms rank 1, near-symmetric), fully exposed in the local trace clock (compute_overlap_ms=0.0), attributed to the c10d.allreduce_ call (asyncop=True) under project.invoke with coverage 1105/1105 kernels associated, 0 unassociated and 0 ambiguous forward sequences, and linked to the single observed 475 MB state:model bucket by gradient-storage membership. The torch collector already ran and supplies the required communication_kernel_sum_ms plus this collective/kernel/bucket/payload evidence, so it is not re-selected. Open questions that matter for deciding the next communication candidate, and one collector each: (1) nccl_tuning - the RING_LL entry name alone does not identify the actual protocol; warmed-worker INIT/ENV/TUNING logs are needed for the real algorithm/protocol/channel decisions at 497759232 f32 bytes over SHM/direct/direct (2 channels, P2P disabled both directions), which is the main tuning lever any environment-level candidate could reach. (2) collective_calibration - a separate warmed synthetic full-world SUM allreduce at the actually observed layout (Float, 124439808 elements, world 2) with correctness checks gives a clean reference duration to compare against the in-step 34.601/33.079 ms kernel time that includes waiting; treated strictly as a reference experiment, not a lower bound or critical-path estimate. (3) execution_timeline - with the collective fully exposed after the last no_sync-accumulated backward, step time splits into host dispatch, 4 eager microbatch forward/backwards, the single allreduce submission, foreach=False SGD tail and the completion-boundary synchronize; a separate plain Torch trace with CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, synchronization and per-device intervals plus reported clock alignment bounds (CPU submissions only) is the right instrument for submit-side attribution; it never replaces a communication hook. (4) nsys - available (request tools, capability probe status available) and useful for the remaining overlap/exposure questions: an independent merged cross-rank kernel timeline with native cuda_runtime-to-kernel correlation confirming the collective is serialized after backward compute and that no other device work (e.g. memcpy or SGD updates) fills its window; caveats respected - it will not be read as separating NCCL waiting from wire transfer, and bucket identity is already established by observed membership so no extra bucket-proof burden is placed on it; no GPU counters requested. Excluded with reasons: device_telemetry (device-wide NVML rates/utilization with native windows, idle samples already observed, NVLink probe not_supported; cannot advance a kernel-duration or step_ms question), python_runtime (perturbs execution; inclusive/self times are not clean scores or GPU durations; no host-dispatch anomaly in evidence and CPU-side attribution is covered by execution_timeline/nsys), candidate_diagnostics (no open exception or False-return question; the installed fixed-observation-route bundle was independently accepted with quality pass, and empty events would not establish which successful path executed), binding_cost (whole-invocation additive-binding overhead of the already-accepted bundle is not a lever for the next communication candidate and is already covered by its accepted paired measurement; also not applicable for planning before a new candidate exists).
